visualCharacteristics: default: grey link tiles (headline + arrow) centred 1/2/3/4/5 per row; expandable: white icon tiles in a 1/2/3 column grid opening an info panel (group titles, label/value rows) below the tiles; live chat tile (blue)
contentPattern: default: one row per tile = link (text = headline). expandable: rows ":icon:" | label | "live-chat" | link | panel content (h3 group title, h4 row label followed by values).
